reviews.name: Fernanda
reviews.text:
We had a great one-week stay here with 3 adults and 3 children. The location is excellent—very convenient, in a safe, accessible neighborhood, with everything we needed nearby.

The building has 24/7 security, which gave us peace of mind. Our flight arrived in the middle of the night, and the security staff were very welcoming and helpful.

The host was very responsive, accommodating, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay.

As it has already been mentioned, the apartment is on the 5th floor and there is no elevator. It can be challenging at first, especially with luggage or young children, but we got used to it after a few days.

I would definitely book this place again.

reviews.name: Andrés
reviews.text: I think it was such a cute place and my family enjoyed it.

reviews.name: Renata
reviews.text: We had a great stay. I do have to mention that the place is on the 5th story but we just took it as exercise! The place was nice, clean and peaceful. There is no AC but there was plenty of fans to choose from in each room that made a difference. We felt safe to walk around even late at night. There are many cute coffee shops and restaurants all around. We have an issue with shower and they came the same day and fixed it. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.name: Regina
reviews.text: One of the nicest AirBnB's my family has stayed in! The area is very friendly and safe with a very convenient pharmacy infront, a convenience store and down the street some restaurants and a park. The apartment was very neat and the beds very comfortable. Clean towels, clean restrooms, fans in the closet for the heat if needed. They did a courtesy cleaning which I thought would only be sweeping or mopping but they actually went above and beyond to clean it while we were there. I appreciate how responsive the hosts are. And helpful. Everything is perfect. I would recommend it because its very comfortable with two bathrooms, and the area outside is wonderful! Its located in a very nice spot centric to the city so we got to our destinations in the estimated times!

reviews.name: Ricardo
reviews.text:
¡Tuvimos una excelente estancia! Nos hospedamos 6 personas por 5 noches y  estuvimos muy cómodos. La ubicación es ideal, con dos estaciones de metro a unos 7 minutos caminando y el metrobús a solo una cuadra, lo que hizo muy fácil movernos por la ciudad. El departamento estaba muy limpio, bien cuidado y con todo lo necesario. Las camas son muy cómodas y el sofá de la sala fue perfecto para descansar después de recorrer la ciudad. 
Además, hay cafeterías, restaurantes y tiendas de conveniencia muy cerca. Recorrimos la zona en distintos momentos del día y siempre nos pareció segura y tranquila.
Los anfitriones fueron muy amables y atentos; respondieron rápidamente a nuestras dudas, nos permitieron ingresar una hora antes y el proceso de entrada fue muy sencillo. Tuvimos un pequeño inconveniente con el calentador, pero lo resolvieron de forma oportuna .

Sin duda, recomendamos ampliamente este alojamiento. Nos llevamos una muy buena experiencia y volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí.

reviews.name: Roberto
reviews.text: Todo muy bien, fue una estancia corta pero muy agradable

reviews.name: Mateo
reviews.text:
We had a great experience staying here! The security was top-notch, which made us feel very comfortable throughout our stay. The location was also great, and the burgers across the street were absolutely delicious!

The apartment was clean and everything worked as expected. They even came by to clean the apartment mid-week, which was a really nice touch. The checkout requirements were minimal and very easy to follow.

Communication was excellent. Every question we had was answered very quickly, and we had no issues during our stay.

One thing to note: if you plan on using the pool, a swim cap is required. We didn’t have one, so unfortunately my daughter wasn’t able to use the pool, which was a little disappointing. However, this was clearly something we should have checked in the listing beforehand.

Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend staying here!

reviews.name: Juan
reviews.text:
Amazing support staff and owner. Any issues you have they jump on it. 

Pros: lots of space, amazing jacuzzi, king bed. Walking distance to Antara (mall) and Palacio de Hierro + so many delicious restaurants. Also close to Costco and Walmart. 

Cons: It’s CDMX so it’s very noisy, but I found it very hard to sleep most of the time. Theres a gelato shop next door that stays open until 2am and you can hear everyone talking through the walls. The traffic one street over has horns going most of the day. And there construction everywhere. But like I said that’s CDMX. I tried 4 other Airbnbs in different sections of the city and had same results. It is what it is.

Sin embargo, lo antendieron y ya no hubo problema el resto de los días. La zona es maravillosa y cada vez que vamos a la ciudad, esta es la zona en la que nos quedamos. Gracias por el lindo detalle de las amenidades de llegada, el cereal, leche y café genuinamente se agradece. Sin duda regresaremos a hospedarnos aquí.

reviews.name: Gonzalo
reviews.text:
Todo estuvo bien con el alojamiento; sin embargo, tuve una experiencia muy desagradable al olvidar un pantalón nuevo en una de las habitaciones.
Aproximadamente 20 minutos después de salir, recordé que lo había dejado sobre la cama. Incluso, antes de irme, el personal de limpieza ya se encontraba en el lugar y me preguntó si podían comenzar con la limpieza, a lo que respondí que sí.
En cuanto me di cuenta del olvido, contacté al anfitrión y regresé de inmediato. Al llegar, toqué varias veces, pero el personal de limpieza no me abrió. Tuve que esperar alrededor de 15 minutos más, y solo después de que el anfitrión se comunicó con ellos me permitieron entrar.
Lamentablemente, para ese momento el pantalón ya no estaba y nunca apareció. Agradezco que el anfitrión haya intentado ayudarme, pero considero muy desafortunado que, después de regresar tan rápido y avisar de inmediato, mi pertenencia se haya perdido.

reviews.text: Our family had a wonderful stay at this gorgeous home during our one week trip in Mexico city. The place was spotless and looked even more beautiful than the photos. We appreciated having plenty of towels, toilet paper, and blankets. Each bedroom was comfortable with either an AC or a ceiling fan.  It was such a thoughtful touch to find breakfast cereal, coffee, milk, juice, and water waiting for us when we arrived. The location was perfect, walking distance to great restaurants and shopping. Our hosts responded quickly to anything we needed. We would happily stay here again!

Stayed with friends but when i return with my family I’ll definitely stay here.

reviews.text: Nice place in a great, very walkable location! The host was attentive and kind. The only downside was the lack of information about the apartment being part of a shared house. The only separation between our space and the rest of the home was our bedroom door, so we could hear conversations from the downstairs living room. We had also requested a crib in advance, but it wasn’t set up until the day after our arrival, which meant we had to improvise by placing cushions on the floor and sleeping next to the baby. Otherwise, the apartment is very clean, in a central location in Polanco and very quiet.

reviews.text: This was my 2nd time staying here, and both times were great experiences. It has the perfect layout for my family and myself to be comfortable and have our own space. Very secure location and walking distance to so many things. Overall just a great place to stay.

reviews.name: Sebastián
reviews.text: We had a great stay with six of us (each person had their own bathroom and two people shared one bedroom with the two single beds). The apartment is very functional with each bedroom having its own bathroom. It was easy to get around in Polanco and we enjoyed renting the city bikes nearby. The separate loft does require you to take stairs that are outside (thanks for another reviewer for pointing this out), and the rooftop is communal. We would stay here again.

reviews.name: Laura
reviews.text:
The location is great and the neighborhood is beautiful. Very walkable and close access to stores, coffee shops, and restaurants. 

Each bedroom has its own bathroom on the second floor. The downstairs has a nice living room and kitchen/dining room. We had an issue with 1 toilet, but they came out immediately and fixed it. I was a little frustrated to learn that the loft was only accessible from stairs that were outside. There were no pictures of the outside access before I booked the Airbnb. This is the main reason for the 4 star review or else  I would have given 5.

reviews.name: Roberto
reviews.text:
Santi was such an amazing host. We had my bachelorette with 15 people, and they were so attentive and flexible with us. They allowed us to drop off our bags early and store them there when we were waiting for our flight. They responded so quickly whenever we had questions! The girls had such a fun time catching up and hanging out at the airbnb. It was the perfect place for all of us after a long day.

Each of the rooms had an AC units, fans, and bathrooms, which made getting ready so easy with a group our size. We would 100% stay here again in the future!! Thank you for having us!!

reviews.name: Pablo
reviews.text: Beautiful neighborhood. The place is very nice. I would stay there again.

reviews.name: Patricia
reviews.text: Would definitely stay again! Location was great!

reviews.name: Patricia
reviews.text: Well located, easy access to Metro and walkable! Lots of food options, close to Masaryk (main shopping area) and had sufficient space to fit a big family of 11. Comfortable, spacious, great location! The house needs a few repairs (like a few toilets with very low water pressure) and it seems like they are working on it. Overall great location for a quick trip to CDMX close to everything

reviews.name: Ximena
reviews.text: Stayed with a total group of 9 family members and this place was exceptional! Each bedroom had their own bathroom which was the biggest plus. All rooms were clean, free of clutter, and comfortable. There are some stairs in the main house that leads to all the bedrooms which the host let me know ahead of time, but the stairs were easy for everyone to climb up and down from. We also had a couple stay at the loft which is on the third floor and this stay was nice too! So much space for everyone in our group to feel comfortable in. The area is totally safe, walkable to nearby pharmacy, restaurants, and a Walmart.  I wouldn’t say the neighborhood is totally quiet as there are local traffic sounds that can be heard but during hours you’re already awake by - during the late night it was totally quiet! Finally Santi and his team stocked the fridge with some water and juice, and some cereal for our group! Overall we had a fantastic stay, would highly recommend for a large group!

We were grateful that basic toiletries and some breakfast foods were provided with our stay.
Santiago was quick to respond whenever we reached out for minor hiccups during our stay. 
Definitely recommend this host and his properties.

We also appreciated the 24-hour security, which gave us peace of mind and allowed us to relax and enjoy our stay without any worries. The host was responsive, and communication was excellent throughout our visit.

We had a wonderful experience and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
Excelente en todo. 100% recomendado.

1. Seguridad: Me sentí muy seguro durante toda la estancia. La zona es tranquila.
2. Relación calidad-precio: Inmejorable por el precio. Vale cada peso.
3. Exacto a las fotos: El lugar es idéntico a las fotos del anuncio, sin sorpresas.
4. Limpieza: Impecable y muy bien cuidado. Se nota la atención al detalle.
5. Internet: El wifi es muy rápido y estable, perfecto para trabajar.
6. Anfitrión: La respuesta del anfitrión fue tan rápida y detallada que hasta me dio pena. Un 10/10.

Volvería a hospedarme sin dudarlo. ¡Gracias!

reviews.name: Andrés
reviews.text: Great place to stay in Polanco, a few minutes walk from commerce and plenty of restaurants in Polanquito. The place is small but comfortable, with everything you might need to relax and unwind after a day of walking around Mexico City. It is not the most private as the apartment sits in a common court with views to other apartments, but it was very quiet and peaceful when we stayed there. It looks like a new build, so it was very clean, modern, and with all the appliances for a short stay. Although it was not a problem to us, do note that you have to go through a flight of stairs to access, especially with large and heavy luggage or restricted mobility. Lastly, the team is incredibly responsive and helpful. The check in process was very smooth, and they were very proactive in staying in touch and making sure that they were always available for any questions or assistance.

reviews.text:
We were a group of 5 (4 adults and 1 child) and stayed at Iris’ place for 8 nights. The setup included two connected lock-off apartments, which offered a nice balance of privacy and shared space. While the apartments are on the smaller side, they are charming, comfortable, and fully livable.

Check-in was seamless, and communication with Iris was fast and super easy throughout our stay.

The apartments were well-equipped with everything we needed, and having access to a laundry room was a great bonus.

The location is excellent, surrounded by plenty of restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacies, and other conveniences. Definitely a top spot!

We would absolutely book this place again. Highly recommended!

This was a great space! I really enjoyed how easy it was to get around from the airbnb and how comfortable the space felt for me and my friend. I was working from Mexico City for a few days and strong internet was a top priority for me — the wifi here did not disappoint, it was extremely fast! 

The only thing i’ll note is that there was construction going on in the building and it was a bit loud during the day while taking calls, but after talking to the team they did their best to coordinate with construction and the noise levels decreased significantly! 

Overall would recommend to anyone visiting CDMX, and I surely plan to be back!!

Staff? 11/10. Location 10/10. Actual space 10/10. Safety 10/10. 

I explored, what felt like, all of roma Norte from here and every time I returned I felt right at home. The bed is fantastic and large while the place is on a busy road you cannot hear a thing. 

Thanking the team once again for all their communication, engagement and for creating such a warm, modern and functional space.

reviews.name: Laura
reviews.text:
I had an excellent stay at this 1-bdrm Conchita apt in Roma Sur & would def recommend it to anyone visiting CDMX. From the moment I arrived, I felt comfortable.

The space was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed. The apartment had everything I needed for a relaxing stay, and the bed was very comfortable. I appreciated how peaceful the apartment was at night, allowing for a great night’s sleep after busy days exploring the city. The hosts were fantastic and even provided a complimentary professional apartment cleaning during my stay.

One of the things I enjoyed most was the location in Roma Sur. The neighborhood has a wonderful local feel and strikes a great balance between being lively and relaxed. I loved walking around the area, discovering neighborhood cafés, restaurants, bakeries, and small shops. It felt authentic and welcoming.

I loved my time here and hope to return in the future!

reviews.name: Andrés
reviews.text:
Sin duda la mejor opción que pude encontrar y mas por mi peludos, fueron felices tomando el sol en la terraza. Me sentí como en casa.
Sin duda esto es un claro ejemplo de servicio al cliente siempre atentos y dispuestos a tus dudas, yo estuve muy satisfecho.
Todo esta igual a las fotos, un alojamiento céntrico, tranquilo, muchas opciones para ir a comer y caminar
Gracias Natalia y equipo, espero pronto vernos =)

reviews.name: Natalia
reviews.text: Es de mis Airbnb favoritos en CDMX. Gran localización, comodidad, súper limpio y es tal cual como se ve en las fotos. Lo que más me gusta es la comunicación con el host, contestan súper rápido y siempre te dan soluciones.

reviews.name: Tomás
reviews.text: Nos hemos quedado ya varias veces aquí y sin dudar cada vez que podemos nos volvemos a hospedar en estos apartamentos porque nos sentimos como en casa, muy cómodos, seguros y felices, los recomendamos siempre.

reviews.name: Verónica
reviews.text: Ya van 2 veces que me quedó en este hospedaje y sobre todo lo hacemos porque es Pet Friendly. La ubicación es genial, puedes ir caminando a todas partes. El lugar es totalmente idéntico a las fotos. La comunicación con los hosts siempre es buena. Me parece una excelente opción de hospedaje.

reviews.name: Regina
reviews.text: Todo excelente!

reviews.name: Isabella
reviews.text: Esa la cuarta vez que nos quedamos, y estamos encantados, sin duda nos volveríamos a hospedar, nos sentimos como en casa siempre que volvemos.

reviews.name: Ana
reviews.text: Muy bien todo la verdad!

reviews.name: Renata
reviews.text:
Viajamos con 2 perritos y fue la estancia perfecta para quedarnos. Cuenta con un balcón y las fotos son exactamente como el lugar se encuentra. Es un espacio moderno y amplio. 
La comunicación con el soporte a tu estancia espacio buenísima. Está en una zona estratégica y súper bien conectado. Seguramente regresaremos :)

reviews.name: Luis
reviews.text: Buena ubicación,lindo departamento y me dejaron entrar con mis perritos 🐶 🙏🏻💖

reviews.name: Laura
reviews.text:
Quiero agradecer profundamente la atención recibida en este airbnb. 
Es un edificio donde hay varios departamentos lindos y cómodos y fue siempre un agrado regresar en las tardes de vuelta de los paseos (a lo que consideraba ya como mi casa... :) Siempre estuvo todo impecable y oliendo muy rico!
Cuando necesité preguntar algo, me apoyaron de inmediato con la mejor disposición y amabilidad como tienen todos los mexicanos.
El edificio está en un barrio precioso, lleno de restaurantes y todo tipo de servicios.
Puedes salir tranquilamente a recorrer sus lindas calles que están llenas de vida y entretención.
Agradezco de corazón la atención recibida y recomiendo a ojos cerrados este lugar. 
Les deseo todo el éxito del mundo porque realmente se lo merecen 💕💕 Espero verlos muy pronto y mi México querido, me los llevo en el corazón ! ❤️

reviews.name: Sebastián
reviews.text: El departamento tiene una ubicación inmejorable: restaurantes, farmacias y tiendas a unos pasos. Es cómodo, de fácil acceso y la zona se siente muy segura. La atención de Natalia y el equipo de Maiahome fue de las mejores que he tenido en un Airbnb; siempre pendientes de que no me faltara nada. ¡Sin duda volveré cada vez que visite la ciudad!

reviews.name: Santiago
reviews.text: It was very clean. It was extremely spacious, it was nice and felt like home. I Loved the fact it was convenient and not far from the University that I was dropping my daughter off at.  Me and my family were close by and I would definitely stay there every time I go to visit my daughter at school!

reviews.name: Verónica
reviews.text: The house was big enough for my family to sleep comfortably. It was very clean. And the house was beautiful.

reviews.name: Valeria
Laura
reviews.text: Wonderful host, helped us check in a super short notice, the place was fantastic for our needs, and our large family, thanks for your kind support during our stay

reviews.name: Alejandro
reviews.text: I was really happy and impressed with the home. I was a little worried about the location but we had no problems at all. We were in town for a World Cup game and the location was really close to the stadium. All beds were comfortable and bathrooms and kitchen were very nice!

reviews.name: Diego
reviews.text:
Very well communicative team. 
Any issues that arose were quickly addressed 

Thank you again.

reviews.name: Alejandra
reviews.text: My family and I stayed for a night. No issues. It was a little noisy from the train/street. But other than that it was fine. Good communication, responding quickly. Comfortable stay.

reviews.name: Eduardo
reviews.text: Excelente estancia! Tal cual las fotos, muy buena ubicación, vecindario muy tranquilo y seguro, enfrente había seguridad. El acceso al edificio muy seguro, con seguridad las 24 horas! Muy limpio, muy grande, excelente para nuestra estancia!

reviews.name: Eduardo
reviews.text: Mi familia y yo quedamos encantados! Realmente el lugar igual o mejor que en las fotos, muy cómodo, limpio, con todas las comodidades y hasta con un kit de bienvenida buenisimo! Lo disfrutamos mucho, encontramos todo muy organizado y limpio, además que responden casi de manera inmediata y nos enviaron instrucciones y recomendaciones con anticipación y muy claros! Definitivamente volveríamos! Recomendado 100%!!!

reviews.name: Eduardo
reviews.text:
Increíble ubicación, limpieza, fácil de accesar. Íbamos 7 personas y nos encantó que todos tuvimos habitación y baño propio. Los anfitriones estuvieron pendiente todo el tiempo y respondían muy rápido. Agradezco también la recomendación que me hicieron para elegir el lugar para comer.
Sin duda alguna volvería.

reviews.name: Óscar
reviews.text: This was one of the nicest places I have stayed. Spacious. Beautiful. Near great parks, restaurants and window shopping. My older son went into Cartier to look around. Didn’t buy anything 😂. You can find just about anything in this area.

reviews.name: Sofía
reviews.text: Perfect place for our group of 6.   Whilst we were there for 4 days we found it located in a quiet and peaceful street in Polanco.   Close to  shops, cafes, bars and restaurants.   We visited the anthropology museum, parks, shops, restaurants, bars and the azteca pyramids/hot sir ballooning .  We were also in Mexico City for the World Cup, Mexico vs England, and as England fans we found the Mexicans very welcoming and friendly.   Will be back to visit the City when the World Cup isn’t on.

reviews.name: Fernanda
reviews.text: Nos encanto el lugar, las habitaciónes son amplias y comodas

reviews.name: Alejandra
reviews.text: Excelente ubicacion,  Departamento muy Espacioso, muy limpio y muy completo.

reviews.name: Emiliano
reviews.text: Excelente lugar, súper recomendado. El apartamento es increíble, de fácil acceso para personas mayores y puede alojar fácilmente familias grandes. La atención fue muy buena, todo el tiempo pendientes y reactivos a las consultas. Limpieza/espacioso/moderno/excelente atención.

reviews.name: Valeria
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was comfortable, clean, and in a great location. It was perfect for our family and made it easy for us to explore Mexico City. The host was very helpful, responsive, and made us feel welcome. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Mexico City. We would happily stay here again! ❤️

reviews.name: Daniela
reviews.text: The appartement was very clean and spacious. Natalia and her team were very helpful and responded immediately. The neighbourhood is very nice and safe. Many restaurants around. We'll book again if we go to Mexico city.

featured.name: Mia
featured.text: El departamento es hermoso, solo tuvimos un inconveniente con el boiler la primera mañana y desafortunadamente era el día del bautizo de mi bebé, por lo que nos retrasó muchísimo porque el agua estaba helada. Ante este tipo de urgencias a las 5am no hubo respuesta hasta después de las 9am, entiendo perfecto que no estarán 24hrs, pero si considero que deberían tener algún mecanismo porque no es normal que tus huéspedes te llamen a esa hora. Sin embargo, lo antendieron y ya no hubo problema el resto de los días. La zona es maravillosa y cada vez que vamos a la ciudad, esta es la zona en la que nos quedamos. Gracias por el lindo detalle de las amenidades de llegada, el cereal, leche y café genuinamente se agradece. Sin duda regresaremos a hospedarnos aquí.

featured.name: Lily
featured.text:
We had a great experience staying here! The security was top-notch, which made us feel very comfortable throughout our stay. The location was also great, and the burgers across the street were absolutely delicious!

The apartment was clean and everything worked as expected. They even came by to clean the apartment mid-week, which was a really nice touch. The checkout requirements were minimal and very easy to follow.

Communication was excellent. Every question we had was answered very quickly, and we had no issues during our stay.

One thing to note: if you plan on using the pool, a swim cap is required. We didn’t have one, so unfortunately my daughter wasn’t able to use the pool, which was a little disappointing. However, this was clearly something we should have checked in the listing beforehand.

Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend staying here!

featured.name: Justin
featured.text: One of the nicest AirBnB's my family has stayed in! The area is very friendly and safe with a very convenient pharmacy infront, a convenience store and down the street some restaurants and a park. The apartment was very neat and the beds very comfortable. Clean towels, clean restrooms, fans in the closet for the heat if needed. They did a courtesy cleaning which I thought would only be sweeping or mopping but they actually went above and beyond to clean it while we were there. I appreciate how responsive the hosts are. And helpful. Everything is perfect. I would recommend it because its very comfortable with two bathrooms, and the area outside is wonderful! Its located in a very nice spot centric to the city so we got to our destinations in the estimated times!

featured.name: Olivia
featured.text:
I had an excellent stay at this 1-bdrm Conchita apt in Roma Sur & would def recommend it to anyone visiting CDMX. From the moment I arrived, I felt comfortable.

The space was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed. The apartment had everything I needed for a relaxing stay, and the bed was very comfortable. I appreciated how peaceful the apartment was at night, allowing for a great night’s sleep after busy days exploring the city. The hosts were fantastic and even provided a complimentary professional apartment cleaning during my stay.

One of the things I enjoyed most was the location in Roma Sur. The neighborhood has a wonderful local feel and strikes a great balance between being lively and relaxed. I loved walking around the area, discovering neighborhood cafés, restaurants, bakeries, and small shops. It felt authentic and welcoming.

I loved my time here and hope to return in the future!

featured.name: Hannah
featured.text:
We had a wonderful stay and would definitely stay here again. The place was exceptionally clean and well-maintained, and we really appreciated that each bedroom had its own attached bathroom. There was plenty of space for our toddlers to run around and play comfortably.

Being on the second floor worked out great for us since the area below is just the entrance and garage, so we didn't have to worry too much about the noise our kids might be making. The location was also fantastic—very walkable, with lots of restaurants, parks, and other amenities nearby. Since the place is located in the city and directly across from a school, there was some noise throughout the day and into the evening, but that's to be expected given the convenient, central location.

Overall, the home was spacious, spotless, well-equipped, and perfect for our family. Highly recommend!

featured.name: William
featured.text:
¡Tuvimos una excelente estancia! Nos hospedamos 6 personas por 5 noches y  estuvimos muy cómodos. La ubicación es ideal, con dos estaciones de metro a unos 7 minutos caminando y el metrobús a solo una cuadra, lo que hizo muy fácil movernos por la ciudad. El departamento estaba muy limpio, bien cuidado y con todo lo necesario. Las camas son muy cómodas y el sofá de la sala fue perfecto para descansar después de recorrer la ciudad. 
Además, hay cafeterías, restaurantes y tiendas de conveniencia muy cerca. Recorrimos la zona en distintos momentos del día y siempre nos pareció segura y tranquila.
Los anfitriones fueron muy amables y atentos; respondieron rápidamente a nuestras dudas, nos permitieron ingresar una hora antes y el proceso de entrada fue muy sencillo. Tuvimos un pequeño inconveniente con el calentador, pero lo resolvieron de forma oportuna .

Sin duda, recomendamos ampliamente este alojamiento. Nos llevamos una muy buena experiencia y volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí.

featured.name: Joshua
featured.text: Great place to stay in Polanco, a few minutes walk from commerce and plenty of restaurants in Polanquito. The place is small but comfortable, with everything you might need to relax and unwind after a day of walking around Mexico City. It is not the most private as the apartment sits in a common court with views to other apartments, but it was very quiet and peaceful when we stayed there. It looks like a new build, so it was very clean, modern, and with all the appliances for a short stay. Although it was not a problem to us, do note that you have to go through a flight of stairs to access, especially with large and heavy luggage or restricted mobility. Lastly, the team is incredibly responsive and helpful. The check in process was very smooth, and they were very proactive in staying in touch and making sure that they were always available for any questions or assistance.

featured.name: Stella
featured.text: Our family loved our stay! It was complete, clean, comfortable, safe, and perfectly located. It was walking distance to a lot of places like cafes, restaurants, and malls (30 minute walk to one of some museums). I also appreciate the smooth check-in process and the quick response from the owner especially when we have inquiries or requests. (Like when there was one door knob that needed change and they repaired it ASAP.) We have young children and a baby with us and it really helped that things like crib, highchair, tub, and even stool were provided. It is indeed a family friendly home. There was just a construction going on while we were there but they gave us a heads up and made sure to inform us of the time they would be working. Overall, I would definitely recommend this home to families and friends!
